text_simplified: This text discusses the rights of children in Islam, mentioning Prophetic ahadith that urge good treatment of children and their care. It also highlights the importance of *tarbiyah* (upbringing) of children upon religious and moral values. It emphasizes that children are an *amanah* (trust) upon the necks of parents.
